thread:
marta: Quick check — for the debug dumps we collect from infra (agent logs + perf traces + occasional core dumps), do we have to retain raw copies longer for support? trying to confirm retention + who can access before I ship the new debug-upload feature.
jason: Short answer: default retention is 30d for raw logs, 90d for traces. Core dumps are high-risk; prefer scrubbed extracts unless sec approves. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/data-retention 
nate: We shouldn't keep raw core dumps in plaintext S3 unless they're encrypted + ACL-limited. Prefer scrub-and-sample. If you need PII for debugging, use ephemeral upload to a support-only bucket with 7d TTL.
marta: ok — for the feature i plan to auto-upload when user opts-in. Implementation idea: gzip -> scrub via logstash filter -> s3://redwood-debug/<env>/<ts>. Any immediate concerns?
leah: sounds reasonable. Make sure to remove all HTTP headers that might contain auth tokens. Also strip IPs (ipv4/ipv6) and user-agent strings that can leak internal tooling.
devops-bot: upload-service-deploy succeeded: build #9872 :white_check_mark:
jason: example scrub snippet that we use as baseline: ```bash
# remove bearer tokens
sed -E 's/(Bearer|Authorization): [^\\s]+/\\1: <REDACTED>/I' \
  | sed -E 's/([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/<REDACTED_IP>/g'
```
nate: Also redact email addresses and any long numeric ids (>8 digits). For traces: keep spans, durations, error tags; drop full stack frames if they include source file paths with usernames or absolute paths.
marta: who can approve access to raw dumps for SRE/support if we need deeper investigation? need a quick flow to implement.
leah: file an infra-access request in the portal and tag it "debug-dump-access". For emergencies PM me directly. We use short-lived access tokens (<=24h) and require an approval audit in the ticket. Also tag uploads with `sensitive=true` so audits pick them up.
jason: :thumbsup: i'll add a retention header in uploads: TTL=7d for support uploads, TTL=30d for full diag (full diag requires sec sign-off).
nate: happy to review scrub rules before rollout — ping me with a sanitized sample and the PR.
marta: thanks team — will open PR and attach sample. Targeting Wednesday. Action items: @jason add scrub step to pipeline, @leah confirm access flow details in infra portal, @nate review scrub rules and sample.
